sections.content: Semantic tags describe meaning: <header>, <nav>, <main>, <article>, <section>, <aside>, <footer> replace generic <div> soup.
Search engines, screen readers, and other developers all rely on semantics. A page built with semantic tags is accessible by default.
Key points: one <main> per page, <nav> for navigation blocks, <article> for self-contained content, and landmarks help keyboard users skip around.
